subject: SIG preface: clarify evidence owners, scope, and timeline
messages:
From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@pivotech.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-19T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Great call — next step: security questionnaire

Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the latency/throughput details were super helpful for our infra team. Security is the last major blocker for procurement, and our security team asked us to kick off a SIG/CAIQ prefilling so they can start reviewing evidence.

Quick ask: can you confirm what your current SOC 2 status is (Type I/II and most recent audit date), whether you offer a BAA, and who on your side will own evidence collection? We usually request a 2-week window for initial evidence.

If you’d prefer, we can accept a REDACTED prefill or a DocuSign BAA followed by the SIG — whatever speeds things up.

I can loop in our security@pivotech.io alias if that helps.

Thanks,
Tom
VP Product
PivotTech

Attachments: none

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@pivotech.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great call — next step: security questionnaire

Tom — appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers up front, and a few clarifying Qs so we hand the right artifacts over to security: 

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2026-11-30). I’ve attached a short SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf) that highlights scope and control owners.
- BAA: We are able to sign a BAA; happy to start that in parallel.
- Evidence owners: I’ll coordinate evidence from Product Security and Infra (I’ll assign owners once we agree scope).

Couple clarifying questions to determine the questionnaire path (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom):
1) Preferred form: Do you want the full SIG (consensus standard) or a CAIQ shorthand? If you have a custom questionnaire, can you share it or point us to the DocuSign/Drive link?
2) Data residency: Do you require EU-only hosting or just notice of residency?
3) HIPAA: Is a signed BAA mandatory for initial review, or can we provide SOC/HIPAA control mappings first?
4) Evidence window: You mentioned 2 weeks — is that calendar days from prefill submission or from the intake call?

Proposed next steps:
- If SIG: we’ll prefill the SIG Lite fields and attach primary evidence, then move to full SIG answer set on request.
- If CAIQ/custom: share the doc and we’ll propose an owner list + ETA.

Looping in Jonas (sales lead) to keep procurement timelines visible. Monica, can you own evidence coordination if PivotTech confirms SIG?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-19T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great call — next step: security questionnaire (evidence coordination)

Evelyn / Jonas — happy to own this. Quick operational note from infra/security side:

- If PivotTech wants SIG Lite first, I can gather a prefill bundle (SOC summary, network diagram redacted, KMS attestation, encryption at rest statement) within 5 business days.
- Full SIG often requires per-control evidence (policies, screenshots, architecture diagrams). For that, plan 10–14 business days depending on scope.
- For BAAs: legal typically needs an approved template; if they require signature before any data transfer, we can expedite (2–3 business days).

Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@pivotech.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@pivotech.io
Date: 2027-09-20T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great call — next step: security questionnaire

Evelyn / Monica — thanks, that’s helpful. Answers from our side:

- We prefer the full SIG, but starting with a SIG Lite prefill is acceptable to unblock procurement.
- Data residency: US only is fine for now (no EU-only requirement).
- HIPAA: Not in scope for our initial POC; we can re-evaluate for production.
- Evidence window: the security team asked for a 10 business day window from prefill submission for the initial review.

I’ve attached our prefilling spreadsheet (pivotech-sig-prefill.xlsx) — it’s the form PivotTech security uses to track prefill fields and evidence owners. Please fill the owner column and estimated delivery date where applicable.

Also tagging security@pivotech.io for any direct evidence questions.

Tom
VP Product, PivotTech

Attachments: pivotech-sig-prefill.xlsx

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@pivotech.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great call — next step: security questionnaire (plan & owners)

Thanks Tom — got the spreadsheet and noted the 10 business day review window.

Monica — I filled the first pass of the prefill owner column and tentative ETA for deliverables in the Drive link (see below). Can you: 
- Confirm the ETA for the SIG Lite bundle (5 business days from tomorrow) and update the spreadsheet owners for control-level artifacts we’ll need if they ask to expand to full SIG.
- Confirm whether we should redact screenshots or provide time-limited access to an artifacts folder (security prefers signed access vs heavy redactions).

Jonas — I’m proposing a short kickoff with PivotTech security next Wednesday 9/29 at 11am PT to triage any ambiguous questions; want to align commercial milestones accordingly.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/rdw-pivotech-sig-2027
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/rdw-pt-2027-0919

If that works for everyone I’ll send the calendar invite and confirm owners.

Best,
Evelyn

Attachments: none
